notes: 2026-11-21 (owner: 'a second cutroom with his clips you think are worthwhile, some we could animate with his picture in picture or just audio overdub; showcase the learning videos'). Eight bites from the three ink-style store courses (Mental Model 1 and 2, Swing Trading Logic), each a cut (off) with the parent's animated twin (on) started at the bite's offset, so the drawings and captions are the ones already approved; Ken's tile rides on the twins whose source has a crop (t4n, apk, b9h). Four raw coaching moments (a student's RL10 breakthrough, the kettlebells, calculating R, the harsh winter) play as cuts and carry their animation brief on the cut itself; anim-overdub adds the twin on the owner's word (a placeholder twin with no drawing left 404 thumbnails on the page, so none is carried). The desk-style Intraday Decision Tree courses are left out of this build because one clip renders in one style; a desk showcase (the STOD lessons) is its own clip. Two more sessions join at rev 2: bar-by-bar ('where would you get long, 1, 2 or 3'; captions refused with HTTP 429, retry queued) and the Hougaard press gut check (still downloading). Transitions by rule (cutroom-24).

segments.label: Drop both kettlebells: snap back to the zero state instantly
segments.why: coaching, not lecturing: rigidity in one hand, revenge in the other, let go and go
segments.status: MINED 2026-11-21 (VTT 00:38:20 to 00:38:58); b9h carries pip.crop from mental-model-2-v2; no twin yet: anim-overdub draws one from the brief on the owner's word
segments.animation_brief: animate: two hands each holding a kettlebell labelled rigidity and revenge; both drop; a flat line snaps back to zero; captions on 'empty both hands', 'hey dummy, drop the weights and go', 'snap back to the zero state instantly'

segments.label: The rule doesn't care how much money you have on it
segments.why: the systematic and statistical way in one breath: each entry a separate trade, a hypothesis measured in R
segments.status: MINED 2026-11-21 (VTT 00:10:56 to 00:11:42); no twin yet: anim-overdub draws one from the brief on the owner's word
segments.animation_brief: animate: two entries 1A and 1B on a bare price line, each with its own stop and exit, each scored in R with no dollar sign anywhere; captions on 'the rule doesn't care how much money you have on it', 'measuring the result of that hypothesis', 'positive expectancy', 'each entry is a separate trade'
